text:
two of the most formidable players in the Robinhood chain ecosystem announced their launchpad this week and Pons barely budged

• the first was Rialto, a major Robinhood partner
• the second was $CASHCAT which is the most renowned token on Robinhood chain

you would miss the forest for the trees if you simply pay attention to the intraday $PONS price

since that mostly reflects people's kneejerk reaction to announcements and introduction of heavyweight competitors, which has so far proven to be irrational at first

Pons seems to be an even better buy now if you look at the fundamentals, however:

• it has pretty much maintained dominance despite all the new heavyweight launchpads
• e.g. Pons has had an average of 14,666 daily launches over the past week, or an average of 13,611 daily launches since it went live two weeks ago. however, it had 18,707 launches two days ago and 17,300 launches yesterday despite both Rialto and Cashcat announcing their launchpads this week
• fees, mindshare, and Robinhood chain network dominance has remained relatively consistent despite new heavyweight competitors

the only thing that has gone down is price

meanwhile, Pons v2 is expected to go live at any moment and turbocharge $PONS buybacks and burns, while also introducing several features that should result in significantly more tokens being launched on Pons i.e. more fees
quoted:
it's always funny watching people overreact and irrationally panic dump high-conviction plays

yesterday, many panic sold their $PONS tokens because a Robinhood partner launched a new launchpad

so how did the day end for Pons?

1. 18,707 tokens were launched on Pons yesterday

that's 56.71% more tokens than the day before and 67.63% more than two days earlier

that's also a 6-day high for new tokens launched on Pons

2. Pons ended the day with $101.4 million of the total $138.2 million in launchpad volume across Robinhood chain

that's 73.4% of all launchpad volume on Robinhood chain

for context:

• there are about 59 launchpads on Robinhood chain, yet Pons still did nearly 3x more volume than the other 58 launchpads combined yesterday, even after this new launchpad went live
• just one week ago, Pons had a 53% market share. over the past week, it has averaged a 62.5% market share

3. Pons ended the day with $162.5k in revenue

• this is more or less in line with what it has been generating over the past week
• it's even more impressive considering yesterday was a weak day for both BTC and equities, while Robinhood chain activity also cooled somewhat

4. Pons burned 4.29 million tokens over the last 24 hours

• that's above the 7-day average of 3,353,716 tokens per day
• there's still roughly $350k sitting in the buyback wallet, and it's being replenished very quickly through new fees

5. Pons v2 should turbocharge the Pons narrative

• v2 has the potential to increase Pons' market share and strengthen its dominance by allowing tokens to be paired with stocks, stablecoins, and a variety of other assets
• v2 should also maximize revenue for Pons and could potentially double revenue, all else being equal
• that could mean up to 2x more burns even if activity on the platform remains the same, which is remarkable considering Pons has already burned 22% of its token supply in just two weeks
• this is happening while $PONS trades at a 0.626x revenue multiple versus 2.4x for $PUMP, 5.57x for $AERO, 11.8x for $LDO, 22x for $HYPE, and 36.9x for $UNI
• in other words, $PONS is already significantly undervalued relative to other revenue-generating protocols, and v2 looks poised to make that valuation gap even wider

TLDR:

1. there is clearly room for several launchpads to thrive on Robinhood chain
2. every objective metric shows that Pons remains the clear leader and has so far been completely unfazed by the launch of a new competitor
3. if anything, Pons' fundamentals have only improved
and they're about to be turbocharged with the launch of v2 later this week

Meanwhile, Robinhood Chain also faces competition in trading infrastructure, as well as uncertainty from meme fund flows.

Of course, declining revenue doesn't mean buybacks will inevitably stop, nor can it be concluded from this that the entire ecosystem has gone cold.

But one thing is worth watching closely: In a bull market, the trading volume-driven buyback mechanism acts as an amplifier for gains; when the market cools, it can also become an accelerator for declines.

When growth expectations start to waver, the real test is just beginning.

all before the bull run has properly started

Nullmask makes private transactions possible across EVM chains and Solana in the most normie-friendly way imaginable

i'm simplifying the technical details to make this as normie-friendly as possible, but that's the gist of it

you can actually use the product and verify that it works!

TOTAL ADDRESSABLE MARKET (TAM)

what makes Nullmask so incredibly bullish and underrated isn't just how impressive the product is, but the size of its total addressable market

i've never used the ZCash or NEAR blockchains, and the same is true for tens of millions of users across Solana, Robinhood, Base, BNB, and Ethereum

the average crypto user may never touch the ZCash or NEAR blockchains, but they're already using Ethereum, Robinhood, BNB, Solana, and Base

and Nullmask caters to those users

this begs the question:

what is fair value for Nullmask when ZCash and NEAR are both trading at multibillion-dollar valuations?

LET'S TALK ABOUT THE TEAM

when a protocol promises something as ambitious as Nullmask does, you obviously want to know who's building it and whether they're capable of delivering

Nullmask is built by several ZCash contributors, led by Tomas Krnak

Tomas Krnak helped build shielded ZCash transactions for hardware wallets. his work was funded by the ZCash Foundation and merged into the main ZCash protocol itself

i should also add that the lead dev is doxxed and regularly participates in live interviews!

PARTNERSHIPS & INTEGRATIONS

we've established that the team has serious credentials in the privacy space and that the product is already live and working

but what about partnerships, integrations, and endorsements?

here's a list of industry players Nullmask has collaborated with in some form since launching:

• NEAR Protocol ($11.3 BILLION ATH)
• THORChain ($4.4 BILLION ATH)
• Dashpay
• Beldex
• Quai Network

the team also revealed in a recent AMA that it's in discussions with major wallet providers, including MetaMask, about potentially integrating Nullmask as an additional privacy layer

all of this for a product that isn't even a month old, by the way!

METRICS & REVENUE

Nullmask looks incredibly strong from a fundamentals perspective, but the key question is:

what do the metrics actually look like?

since the protocol launched a little over two weeks ago, Nullmask has generated:

• $37.8 MILLION in total protocol volume, averaging $2.36 million per day
• $833k in total revenue, averaging $52k per day

it has also burnt 2.16% of supply and distributed $1.4 MILLION in $ZEC rewards to holders since the token launched approximately three weeks ago (token launched a week before the protocol)

and here's the important part:

all these adoption metrics were recorded before the protocol is live on Solana, which is expected to happen next week, and mostly before it went live on Robinhood and BNB just a few days earlier

the team also has 20% of the token supply allocated to a long-term incentives campaign designed to encourage people to use the protocol and accelerate adoption

i should also add that Nullmask is now ranked #1 among ALL privacy protocols for both 7-day and 30-day revenue, according to DeFiLlama, barely two weeks after its protocol went live, and by a clear margin

this is despite the fact that 

-it only went live on Robinhood and BNB a few days earlier
- it is yet to launch on Solana
- its incentives program aimed at accelerating adoption is yet to launch

the speed of adoption Nullmask has witnessed is impressive for any privacy protocol

TOKENOMICS

20% of the token supply is allocated to the team and locked for two years, meaning these tokens won't start entering circulation until at least two years after token launch

another 20% is reserved for an incentives campaign aimed at accelerating protocol adoption

the remaining 60% of supply is circulating

this means approximately 60% of the supply is currently in circulation, while the bulk of the rest won't enter circulation anytime soon

• Unshield directly to ZEC wallets (October 2026)
• Launch on Solana (Q4 2026)
• NullMask SDK (Q4 2026)
• Privacy Perpetuals (Q4 2026)

TO CONCLUDE

i know Nullmask might sound too good to be true right now, and it's crazy to me that it's sitting at such a ridiculously low market cap

but believe it or not, all of the facts in my thesis above can be independently verified

i'm not going to ask you to buy Nullmask

i'm simply laying out my thesis and thought process for this trade, and explaining why i believe it could be a big one

i objectively believe $MASK will become a multibillion-dollar token before the end of the bull run, and i expect it to be yet another kingmaker trade for me

nothing in this thesis is financial advice

it's up to you what you do with the above information
